constraints: x and output must have the same type
name is not used in this API

output.description: A Tensor with the same type as `x`. Usage Example: >>> x = tf.constant([-128.0, 0.0, 128.0], dtype=tf.float32) >>> tf.sigmoid(x) <tf.Tensor: shape=(3,), dtype=float32, numpy=array([0. , 0.5, 1. ], dtype=float32)> @compatibility(scipy) Equivalent to scipy.special.expit @end_compatibility
